Subsections.Title: Replacement of the Aortic Root in Patients with Marfan Syndrome
Subsections.Description: Guidelines for diagnosis and management of patients with thoracic aortic disease, focusing on indicators for surgical intervention, particularly replacement of the aortic root.

Subsections.Title: Replacement of Primary (Nondissected) Aneurysms of the Aortic Arch, Descending, and Abdominal Aorta in Patients with Marfan Syndrome
Subsections.Description: Discusses surgical approaches and associated risks in treating nondissected aneurysms in Marfan patients.

Sections.Title: Imaging in Loeys-Dietz Syndrome
Sections.Description: Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of aortic disease in patients diagnosed with Loeys-Dietz syndrome.
